node.statement: For all c,d in U(1) and U,V,W in calU, complex bilinearity of bold-dot and conjugate-linearity of dagger from def-epsilon-cstar-algebra give (cU) bold-dot (dV)=(c*d)(U bold-dot V), ((c*d)W) bold-dot H=(c*d)(W bold-dot H), and (cU)^dagger=conj(c)U^dagger. Also c*d and conj(c) lie in U(1), and the stipulated scalar-action codomain gives (c*d)W and conj(c)W in calU. No associativity, positivity, or approximate group law is used.
